method: Static inventory of the ACTUAL embedded DDL across all durable SQLite stores. The cognitive-memory authority (STORE-kria_memory_db) schema is defined by 10 include_str! migration files under crates/kria-core/src/memory/db/schema/0001..0010, applied by crates/kria-core/src/memory/db/migrations.rs and versioned in the schema_version table with a runtime BLAKE3 checksum per applied migration. Pragmas are read from crates/kria-core/src/memory/db/mod.rs configure(). For each migration this artifact enumerates tables (key columns/constraints), indexes, triggers, and virtual (FTS5) tables. A SHA-256 file-byte checksum is computed per migration to establish an F0 migration-checksum baseline independent of the runtime BLAKE3 lineage. Other durable stores (kria.db, skills.db, cpp_grants.db, devices.db and the cpp-knowledge/config/briefing/world-model/quarantine/tasks/safety-audit families) use ad-hoc CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS DDL embedded in Rust; they are inventoried at store/table granularity as competing authorities. The five required categories (competing authority, direct SQL, free-text links, mutable events, obsolete ANN) are flagged with exact file/table locations and a target cutover gate. No secrets or row data copied.
invariants_applied: Dormant code/comments/tests are not capability proof — SqliteVectorStore, IndexTarget::LanceDb/Tantivy labels, vectors.usearch path, and 'LanceDB/Qdrant' comments are classified by LIVE composition (api.rs:274 wires AnnVectorStore), not by name.
MGR-033.1 single SQLite authority: authoritative writes must land in one transactional authority; multiple durable SQLite files are competing authorities.
MGR-033.2 append-only events: event tables must abort UPDATE/DELETE; audit/revision tables must be append-only.
MGR-034 typed records/provenance: relations must be governed by a relation_registry, not free-text rel_type or parallel untyped link tables.
MGR-035.1 single governed write boundary: durable writes must pass WritePolicyEngine; direct AuthorityTx SQL outside submit() is a bypass.
MGR-041 crypto-shred truth: shred_keys must carry key_version/algorithm/destruction_method/proof_hash and status transitions, not a bare status flag.
MGR-042 derived-index convergence: FTS5/vector rows are rebuildable projections and must converge with authority via triggers/outbox/manifest.

pragmas.source: crates/kria-core/src/memory/db/mod.rs configure() (applied to every write and read-pool connection)
pragmas.authority_tx: Database::begin() issues BEGIN IMMEDIATE and holds a single write Mutex (serialized single writer, L10); AuthorityTx rolls back on drop unless commit() is called.
pragmas.integrity: quick_check() available (PRAGMA quick_check); no scheduled integrity_check / event-checksum / outbox-cursor / schema-checksum / derived-manifest release check yet (design §4.4/§5.3 target).
pragmas.network_fs_guard: Linux statfs guard rejects NFS/SMB/CIFS/SMB2 authority paths (L14).
gaps_vs_design_v2: synchronous=NORMAL, but design §4 requires synchronous=FULL for authority commits — MGR-033 durability gap (target F1.1).
No authority_meta singleton, no schema_epoch, no graph_revision counter row (design §4.1) — pragmas/meta table absent.
No deferred foreign-key/invariant pre-commit check and no release/recovery integrity battery (design §4.4/§5.3) — target F1.

migration_checksum_baseline.runtime_machinery: crates/kria-core/src/memory/db/migrations.rs — ordered const MIGRATIONS[] applied once inside a txn; each recorded in schema_version(version PK, applied_at, checksum) with checksum = BLAKE3 hex of the script bytes (ids::blake3_hex). verify_checksum() aborts if an applied migration's script bytes change; applied>latest refuses a silent downgrade (SchemaTooOld). latest_version()=10.
migration_checksum_baseline.baseline_algorithm: SHA-256 of raw file bytes (F0 evidence baseline; independent of the runtime BLAKE3 lineage recorded in schema_version).

other_migration_lineages.machinery: crates/kria-core/src/openclaw/registry.rs — a SEPARATE SCHEMA_VERSION + run_migrations() lineage (capability_profiles/market_catalog/capability_grants_scoped/capability_edges) layered over base CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS DDL. Independent checksum/version machinery from the memory authority.
other_migration_lineages.note: Second migration system in the repo; not covered by the memory schema_version baseline.

other_migration_lineages.machinery: TaskStore, WorldModelStore, QuarantineRegistry, safety AuditLogger, SqliteConfigStore, BriefingStore use bare CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS with no version/checksum ledger.
other_migration_lineages.note: No migration checksum baseline exists for these stores — schema drift is unversioned.
